core_logic_cell_rule: routed ICESTORM_LC used (seed 1) minus the harness flip-flops counted in the harness-only netlist; each harness output multiplexer feeds its own flip-flop and packs into that logic cell, and logic cells are seed-independent here
critical_path_rule: per seed 1000 / achieved Fmax of the slowest clock; the calibration uses the worst of seeds 1, 2 and 3

designs.detail: fixed<8,8> is refused by the graph verifier: the fraction must be smaller than the word width
designs.name: fit_lif_w8

flow: emit the graph with the engine for iCE40 UP5K
yosys: read_verilog -sv design.v (top plus instanced baseline primitives); synth_ice40 -top <graph>; delete t:$scopeinfo; write_json design.json
yosys: synthesise the five-pin shift-register harness against a port stub of the core and merge it with design.json (hierarchy -top sc_ooc_harness; flatten)
core logic cells = routed ICESTORM_LC used minus the harness flip-flops (each harness multiplexer packs with its own flip-flop)
critical path per seed = 1000 / achieved Fmax of the slowest clock

weight_patterns.fit: 0.05 + 0.9*((i*7) mod 11)/10 for weight i: every weight non-zero (0.05 to 0.95)
weight_patterns.folded: ((i*7) mod 11 - 5)/10 for weight i: about half zero or negative, clamped to zero
weight_patterns.random: random non-zero Q8 codes (1 + randrange(256))/256 from random.Random(<design name>)

weight_probes.method: run_resource_feedback (out-of-context harness, nextpnr seed 1) at 12 MHz; seed_base 0x1234, stream_length 7; rate weights quantise to Q8 by truncation (code = floor(256*w), 1.0 -> 256)

rows.weights: all 0.99/256 (largest value that quantises to zero is just below 1/256)
all 0.99/256 (largest value that quantises to zero is just below 1/256)
